last_known_good_commit.description: Complete Stihl Decoder v1.1 release with StopHeling scan, static model cards, and complete database. Contained 13 serial ranges spanning Plants 1, 2, 3, and 8, covering chainsaws, blowers (BR 340/420, BR 600), and brushcutters (FS 120/250, FS 130). No model acted as a mass fallback.

first_bad_commit.description: Implement Serial Breakpoints Engine. Introduced two fatal flaws: (1) Synthesized 25M serial range 145000000–169999999 for MS 260 by merging BR 340/420 (145-159M) and MS 260 Laat (160-169M); (2) Added unconditional mass fallback in decoder.js: '|| database.models.find(m => m.id === \'stihl_ms_261_cm\') || database.models[0]', causing 100% of tested serials across all plants to resolve to MS 261 C-M.

data_loss_commits.summary: Pruned 9 out of 13 historical ranges (041 AV, 026 Vroeg, MS 260 Laat, MS 500i, MS 290 family, BR 340/420, FS 130, FS 120/250) from stihl_database.json.
Omitted Plant 2 (BR 600) and Plant 8 (MS 170) from stihl_database.json when switching from serial_breakpoints to model_serial_ranges, leaving them stranded in seed.js.
Removed MS 201 ranges from model_serial_ranges to align strictly with pilot SEO pages, reducing active canonical database to only 3 ranges in Plant 1.

logic_regression_commits.summary: Unconditional fallback to MS 261 C-M or database.models[0], plus synthetic 25M range for MS 260.
Mass prefix heuristics in decoder.js: '18/17' -> MS 261, '14/15/16' -> MS 260, fallback -> 'MS 261 C-M Gen 2', fallback category -> 'Kettingzaag'. Mapped 95% of test serials to MS 260 / 261.

later_partial_remediations.summary: Removed hardcoded startsWith prefix logic and MS 261 fallback from decoder.js, but left the synthetic 25M MS 260 range in stihl_database.json.
Blocked technical specs from attaching to breakpoint records.
Added SerialChronologyResolver and modelAssist, but froze canonical database at the 3 Plant 1 ranges.

current_residual_defect.database_defect: data/stihl_database.json contains only 3 ranges (all Plant 1). The MS 260 range (145000000–169999999) covers 25,000,000 serials, absorbing 15,000,000 serials that historically belonged to BR 340/420 blowers. Plant 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9 have 0 ranges.
current_residual_defect.engine_defect: Absence of explicit multi-level resolution (EXACT vs PROBABLE vs FAMILY vs PLANT_AND_PERIOD vs UNRESOLVED). StihlRangeResolver returns null if >1 match occurs, preventing graceful multi-candidate Model Assist.
current_residual_defect.ui_state_defect: index.html does not reset currentModelName, currentYearsFormatted, or rendered text fields upon new handleDecode() search, creating potential stale-state leakage after decoding MS 260.
current_residual_defect.seed_drift_defect: data/seed.js retains obsolete serialBreakpointsData from commit 90bb431 while data/seed.cjs loads from data/stihl_database.json.
